title: polygala declinata
intro: Polygala declinata, commonly known as Wild York Cucumber, is a plant species within the milkwort family (Polygalaceae). It is a perennial herb that is native to North America and has been traditionally used in medicine due to its numerous health benefits. The plant is valued for its ability to support immune function and reduce inflammation, and its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of Polygala declinata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
